title: Software Engineer, Regulatory Reporting
description: <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>About Clear Street:</strong></span></p> <div>Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.</div> <div><br>We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.<br><br></div> <div>For more information, visit <a href="https://clearstreet.io/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://clearstreet.io&source=gmail&ust=1766243799031000&usg=AOvVaw2TBe5KeG89pR0V5dJX88v8">https://clearstreet.io</a>.</div> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Team:</strong></p> <p><br>The Regulatory Reporting Engineering team at Clear Street is a small team with a great deal of responsibility. We work closely with stakeholders to ensure that we meet all our financial and regulatory obligations in a timely fashion. Our goal is to make the lives of our stakeholders easier by leveraging innovative technology to create automated solutions for their workflows. As Clear Street grows into more product lines and geographical regions, every member of the team will have an opportunity to have an immense impact on the firm as a whole.  Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where you can make a significant contribution, collaborate with talented professionals, and work with cutting-edge technology to drive operational excellence.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Lead Software Engineer on the Regulatory Reporting Engineering team, you will play an integral role in automating our Compliance & Finance regulatory processes. You'll build on your analytical skills to create solutions that process large amounts of data from our data warehouse to generate clean, correct reporting, including building out reconciliations.</p> <p>You will partner with key stakeholders across the Compliance, Finance, and Treasury teams  to understand regulatory/financial obligations and business requirements, and translate them into clean designs and scalable solutions. As the tech lead in the team, you will provide technical guidance, prioritizing work, perform hands-on design and development and code review,  as well as evolve our technical standards and best practices.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Tech Stack:</strong> Python, SQL, Snowflake, Retool, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo, Metaplane, REST APIs</p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications: </strong></p> <ul> <li>You have at least three (3) years of software design and development experience including CI/CD, source code control, testing, and quality management.</li> <li>You are highly proficient in Python,  SQL, database design, and have experience working with data warehouses like Snowflake to generate complex solutions at scale.</li> <li>You are a self-starter with a sense of urgency and an eagerness to learn and explore new technologies as appropriate to solve business problems.</li> <li>You are a strong communicator who can interact in a clear and concise manner with non-technical business stakeholders, product managers as well engineers.</li> <li>You can troubleshoot and logically assess problems and determine solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have experience working in the post-trade automation space designing and architecting systems that deliver solutions to complex data problems.</li> <li>You have experience generating complex financial industry regulatory reports like EMIR, MFID,  SFTR, CPR, K Factor etc.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>We Offer:</strong></p> <p>At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.</p> <p>Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.</p> <p>Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.</p></div><p>As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.<br><br>You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.<br><br>This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.</p> <ul> <li> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK.</div> <div><strong>Right to Work:</strong> Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.</div> </div> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong><br><br>Own the simulator</p> <ul> <li>Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.</li> <li>Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.</li> <li>Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.</li> <li>Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.</li> <li>Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.</li> </ul> <p>Tune and close the sim2real gap</p> <ul> <li>Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.</li> <li>Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.</li> <li>Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.</li> <li>Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.</li> <li>Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator</li> </ul> <p>Grow into reinforcement learning</p> <ul> <li>Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.</li> <li>Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.</li> <li>Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.</li> <li>Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.</li> <li>Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.</li> <li>Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).</li> <li>Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.</li> <li>Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.</li> <li>Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.</li> <li>Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.</li> <li>Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).</li> <li>Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.</li> </ul> <p>The expected base salary range for this role i<strong>s</strong> GBP 70,000 - 120,000 <strong> </strong>based on external market data, plus bonus and equity. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions.<br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Additional Information </strong></p> <p>Locus Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.</p> <p>Application Fraud Detection Notice: To help maintain a fair and secure hiring process, Locus Robotics may use AI-assisted and other automated tools to detect suspected fraud, misrepresentation, or misuse of the application process. Hiring decisions are not made solely by automated means unless otherwise disclosed where required by law. </p> <p>It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
location: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.</li> <li>Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.</li> <li>Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.</li> <li>Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Change Management and Institutional Strengthening</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.</li> <li>Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.</li> <li>Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.</li> <li>Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Implementation and Technical Support</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.</li> <li>Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Learning, Evidence and Innovation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.</li> <li>Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.</li> <li>Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.</li> <li>Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.</li> <li>Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.</li> <li>Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. title: Senior Counsel - Product (UK & EU)
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Join our growing Product Legal team of 10, embedded with Kraken’s Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We’re a tight, experienced group of product lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice - partnering directly with product teams to chart clear, defensible paths to launch. This is a fully remote role for a qualified solicitor in the UK or admitted in an EU jurisdiction. The opportunity The Senior Counsel (Consumer Legal) role is based in the UK or EU within our Consumer Legal team, partnering on cutting edge consumer products including crypto trading, earn, payments, on-chain integrations, equities, and tokenised equities. Reporting to the Head of Consumer Legal, you’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to shape and ship novel consumer products and experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong product development instincts, regulatory fluency, and negotiation skills (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector) combined with a crypto-forward mindset. Curiosity, flexibility, and a bias for action at the intersection of crypto and traditional global markets are essential. What you bring Qualified lawyer (Solicitor of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State). 5+ years’ PQE in financial services law gained at a regulated financial services firm, crypto services provider, or in private practice (ideally with direct product counselling experience). Preference for experience with advising on regulated MiFID investment services and familiarity with relevant crypto-asset regimes, including MiCA, AMLD5, UK financial promotions, and/or e-money regulations. Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing. Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyers and product stakeholders. Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and delivers clear recommendations to decision-makers. Demonstrates an authentic passion for crypto and familiarity with the features of both Kraken and its competitors’ apps and products. Nice to haves Expertise in MiCA framework applicable to CASPs including brokerage, custody and the operation of trading platforms. Expertise in UK crypto-asset financial promotions regime and proposals for incoming authorisation regime for regulating crypto asset service providers. Expertise in MiFID frameworks applicable to investment services including derivatives, equities, funds and emerging tokenised financial instruments. Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase efficient provision of legal services, create custom GPTs allowing stakeholders to self-serve on commoditised legal and regulatory queries. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. title: Director, EMEA Marketing
description: About G2 - The Company G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users. Now, we have joined forces with Capterra , SoftwareAdvice , and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence. And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI. Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK! About G2 - Our People At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— ( P erformance + E ntrepreneurship + A uthenticity + K indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn. You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people. About The Role G2 is looking for a commercially minded marketing leader who is passionate about the software industry and excited to help build G2 EMEA. This role reports to the VP, EMEA and leads marketing for the region, with one direct report. Three things sit at the centre of this job. You own the pipeline G2 generates in EMEA. You own the EMEA event calendar and the pipeline that comes out of it. And you are the connection between the region and G2's central Growth Marketing team, in both directions. Central Growth Marketing markets to buyer personas globally. This role owns the market. You decide what EMEA needs, secure it, adapt it, build what only the region can build, and own the number at the end of it. You also work the other way round: finding the triggers and signals that convert in this region and feeding them back into the global model. You will be the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team, and you will have the autonomy that comes with sitting in the region rather than at the centre. As the Director, EMEA Marketing, you will be a key player in our mission to build the largest and most trusted global software marketplace. In This Role, You Will: Own the EMEA marketing plan, budget, and pipeline target. Serve as the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team and the EMEA voice within central marketing. Translate G2's global GTM strategy into a regional plan built for how European buyers actually buy. Drive EMEA pipeline growth and conversion, covering the full volume of demand generated and how well it converts. Lead EMEA event strategy and execution (executive dinners, sponsored events, partner events, virtual formats), including format, audience, calendar, and spend. Lead the EMEA account-based marketing program, using buyer intent and account signals to prioritize target accounts. Run the weekly pipeline and funnel review with EMEA sales leadership, and manage the marketing-to-sales handoff. Partner with central Growth Marketing to adapt global campaigns and signals for EMEA, feeding regional results back into the global model. Forecast and report on MQA, SQLA, pipeline, revenue, and average contract value using Salesforce and Looker. Manage, coach, and develop one direct report. Minimum Qualifications: We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 7+ years of B2B marketing experience 2+ years leading a lean marketing team in a player-coach capacity, balancing hands-on execution with people management You have hands-on experience designing digital one-to-one and one-to-few ABM campaigns, overseeing event efforts, as well as planning and executing. bottom-of-the-funnel activation programmes. You have owned an event strategy and run executive-level formats that produced pipeline, not just attendance. You’ve previously worked in a B2B company in the sales and marketing tech category. You’ve previously developed and executed an enterprise marketing plan in partnership with Account Development, Sales, and Customer Success teams. You have turned buyer intent or behavioural signals into campaigns that converted, and can show which signals worked and which did not. You’re motivated by results and contribution to pipeline/revenue. You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy creating new ways of working. What Can Help Your Application Stand Out: Have been a G2 customer. Are well-versed in the enterprise software buying process. Experience with our existing tech stack, (SFDC, Marketo, 6Sense and Looker strongly preferred) Experience using AI tools to do the work. description: Senior Content Manager At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform. The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience. Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale. We're reshaping how we plan and create content at Phrase. A new Content Working Group brings together demand generation, SEO and AI search, paid media, marketing ops, localization and creative under one strategic umbrella. The ambition is clear: every piece of content earns its place, engages in its own right and reflects the quality of the platform we build. We're looking for a Senior Content Manager to sit at the centre of this. Someone who thinks editorially, obsesses over audience and brings the creative confidence to raise the bar across everything we publish. You'll own content strategy and planning, develop and maintain our content calendar, brief and manage writers, coordinate our design studio, and work alongside specialists in paid, organic, demand gen and localization who are collectively invested in the work. You'll also be working with the people building our product (genuine thought leaders in AI and language technology) and with external experts in the field, turning deep knowledge into stories that resonate. This is a chance to shape a content function at a company that takes content seriously, in an industry going through one of its most fascinating periods of change. What you’ll be responsible for: Own the content strategy across the full marketing funnel , working within the Content Working Group to shape quarterly plans, balance priorities and ensure every asset has a clear audience, purpose and measurable goal. Develop and maintain the content calendar to keep a consistent, strategically aligned publishing rhythm across channels and funnel stages. Write, commission and edit content across formats: blog posts, reports, video scripts, campaign narratives, case studies, ebooks, email sequences. You'll write well, and edit even better. For high-value pieces (original research, designed reports, narrative campaigns), you'll commission and manage specialist contributors and agencies to deliver work that genuinely stands out. Apply our editorial approach. We want content that people genuinely want to read, watch and share. Content built on original insight, sharp storytelling and distinctive points of view. You'll champion this standard across the team and help inspire others to aim higher. Compile and present content strategy and plans with confidence and conviction, whether to the Content Working Group, senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders. Coordinate the design studio. Two designers support content production, campaigns, reports and communications. You'll plan and prioritise their workload, keeping jobs moving and ensuring the right work gets the right attention at the right time. Think studio manager: organised, clear, good at keeping plates spinning. Harness AI with intention. Phrase has developed a three-tier content model (Gold, Silver, Bronze) that determines how much human creative investment each piece needs. You'll apply this framework, using AI tools where they accelerate production and protecting the space for original, human-led thinking where it matters most. Fly the flag for content. You'll be the person who pushes for great work, brings energy to the process and motivates the people around you to produce their best. Content touches every part of marketing at Phrase, and we need someone who promotes its value, celebrates what's working and holds the standard when it counts. Track what's working. With support from Marketing Operations, use data and analytics to inform what we create next and to demonstrate content's influence on pipeline and business outcomes. title: Senior Product Analyst
description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the role. The Senior Product Analyst, Merchant will be the dedicated analytics lead for Zilch’s Merchant domain - the space where shopping discovery, merchant-funded advertising, paid display, paid search, affiliate conversion, and customer engagement come together. Reporting into Product Analytics and partnering closely with the Senior Product Manager for Merchant, you’ll help build the analytical foundation for Zilch’s intelligent commerce platform. This is a two-sided problem: we need to improve the customer shopping experience while helping merchants drive measurable ROAS through Zilch’s closed-loop payments and behavioural data. Here, paid display and paid search refer to advertising inventory we sell to merchants, not media we buy. You’ll help define how this inventory is measured, targeted, optimised, and monetised across the Zilch app. You’ll analyse the full shopping journey - from browsing and search, through merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat engagement - to understand where users drop off, what drives intent, and which product features can improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation. This is not a reporting-only role. The analysis, experimentation, and models you build will directly shape what customers see, how merchants are surfaced, and how we move from static merchandising towards data-driven discovery, allocation, and personalisation. Day to day responsibilities. Own analytics for Zilch’s Merchant domain, covering shopping discovery, customer browsing behaviour, merchant-funded paid display and paid search, affiliate conversion, merchant ROAS, and marketplace performance. Analyse the customer shopping journey across browsing, search, merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat usage to identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation. Design and analyse experiments across merchant placements and shopping features, including targeted vs random allocation, paid display exposure, search ranking, storefront changes, offer discovery, and journey improvements. Build the measurement framework for merchant-funded growth, including incrementality, attribution windows, exposed vs control logic, ROAS, CPA, conversion, revenue per impression, and margin impact. Partner with Product and Commercial to shape audience packages and targeting strategies, ensuring they are commercially sellable, analytically measurable, and grounded in customer behaviour. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance. You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity. title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
description: About Infrata Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition. Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction. Why this role Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects. You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed. Your impact at Infrata The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery. Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value. Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects. Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement. Key accountabilities Service development Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence. Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand. Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience. Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks. Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself. Business development Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer). Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies. Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches. Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work. Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current. Engagement leadership Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver. Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations. Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off. Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback. Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work. Building the team's consulting capability Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting. Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work. Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata. Service areas in scope The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four. Strategy You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development. Value creation Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews. Climate advisory You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting. Data and digital services You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data. Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability. Who you are Essential experience At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works. Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work. Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue. Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale. Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists. Desirable Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved. Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies. Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure. Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience. Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business. A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada. Capabilities Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly. Writes and presents for senior decision-makers. Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue. Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert. Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required. Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively. Takes initiative and is comfortable developing new services and ways of working, particularly in the first year. Education and languages Degree in engineering, economics, finance, business, environmental science or a related discipline. MBA or equivalent is useful but not required. Fluent English. Mobility Willing to travel to clients and to Infrata and dss+ offices as the work requires. What you'll experience at dss+ Work alongside investors, lenders, operators and governments on live infrastructure decisions. The opportunity to help build our strategic advisory practice. A values-led organisation and a collaborative, inclusive culture. Competitive compensation, performance incentives, flexible working and international opportunities. dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued and able to contribute fully. #LI-CM1 Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Renewals Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
description: <h3><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span class="collapsed-field-text">Senior Renewals Account Manager, Strategic Accounts</span></span></strong></h3> <p><strong>Location: London, UK</strong></p> <h3><strong>Job Overview</strong></h3> <p>Rubrik is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven <strong>Renewals Account Manager</strong> to join our team, focusing exclusively on managing the subscription renewal lifecycle for our <strong>Strategic Accounts</strong> within the region. In this critical role, you will be the primary owner responsible for retaining and growing revenue across our largest and most complex customer base. You will execute a high-touch renewal strategy, ensuring timely execution, maximizing customer outcomes in collaboration with the sales team. Success in this role requires strong executive presence, expert negotiation skills, and a proven ability to orchestrate internal resources across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Renewal Execution:</strong> Own and manage the entire renewal process for a dedicated portfolio of Strategic Accounts, ensuring subscription renewals are executed <strong>240–180 days</strong> ahead of the expiration date to maintain a high-retention rate.</li> <li><strong>Customer and Partner Engagement:</strong> Proactively engage with both the customer's executive stakeholders and our top-tier channel partners to assess renewal risks, communicate value, and negotiate complex contract terms and pricing.</li> <li><strong>Internal Alignment and Review:</strong> Conduct mandatory internal <strong>Account Reviews</strong> for all renewals exceeding a certain<strong> revenue threshold (ACV)</strong>, coordinating alignment with Field Sales and executive leadership to ensure a unified renewal strategy.</li> <li><strong>Negotiation and Proposal:</strong> Develop and present tailored renewal proposals, quotes, and pricing models while expertly navigating commercial negotiations to maximize revenue and margin.</li> <li><strong>Risk Mitigation:</strong> Proactively identify and resolve all issues and friction points during the renewal cycle. Act as a strategic partner to Customer Success to eliminate risk and to drive value realization</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong> Maintain meticulous and accurate records of all customer interactions, forecast statuses, and renewal sentiments and activities within <strong>CRM</strong>, providing management with timely reports and strategic insights on renewal trends.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience in high-touch renewals, account management, or strategic sales, with a proven track record of managing and negotiating complex, multi-million dollar contracts.</li> <li><strong>Executive Acumen:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build relationships with, and effectively communicate complex commercial terms to, senior-level and executive client stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Financial & Analytical Skills:</strong> Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting renewal data, managing financial models (ACV/ARR), and providing accurate revenue forecasts.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Proven ability to work cross-functionally and lead virtual teams (Sales, CS, Finance) to achieve a common renewal goal.</li> <li><strong>Technical Proficiency:</strong> Expert proficiency with CRM systems and forecasting tools is mandatory.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> | <a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.</p> <p>Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact <a ----- ----- Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">EEO IS THE LAW</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/olms/regs/compliance/eo_posters/employeerightsposter2page_19final.pdf" target="_blank">NOTIFICATION OF EMPLOYEE RIGHTS UNDER FEDERAL LABOR LAWS</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Agentic AI Principal
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Agentic AI Principal</strong> to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in the UK and Ireland.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated UK enterprise environments, including financial services and telecommunications.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI Advisory & Strategy: </strong>Shape and solution complex UKI pursuits, working with account, commercial and delivery leaders to translate client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li><strong>Design & Build Engineering:</strong> Set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li><strong>Governance & Safeguards: </strong>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.</li> <li><strong>Principal-level leadership: </strong>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks’ agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Design solutions appropriate for regulated UK environments, including financial services and telecommunications, with strong consideration of data sovereignty, privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, maintaining sufficient hands-on involvement to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, uplift broader engineering capability, and build confidence in agentic AI practices across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in <strong>modern software engineering and Python</strong>, with a <strong>strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</strong></li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory and multi-t coordination patterns.</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices.</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.</li> <li>Strong consulting and commercial judgement, including experience shaping high-value opportunities, building investment cases and contributing directly to complex pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Ability to lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentization, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to move fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.</li> <li>Ability to influence across organisations without relying on formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.</li> <li>Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and to raise standards and capability across a wider engineering community.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Technical SEO Specialist (Legend)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About Legend</strong> </p> <p><em>Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising. Learn more at <a href="l1.com">l1.com</a>.</em></p> <p>Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.</p> <p>Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Legend is hiring a Principal Technical SEO, reporting directly to our Chief Gaming Officer.</p> <p>This is a rare opportunity to take portfolio-wide responsibility for the technical SEO performance of some of the largest and most commercially important domains in iGaming. Working alongside our existing Principal Technical SEO, you will co-own technical SEO across our Gaming portfolio, while also supporting our Sports portfolio.</p> <p>You will identify the technical opportunities and risks that matter most, turn them into clear priorities, and work closely with Product and Engineering to deliver measurable organic and commercial impact. This is a deeply hands-on role where you will solve complex challenges across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, internationalisation, migrations and performance, while setting standards that scale across our portfolio.</p> <p>You will also play a key role in advancing how we use AI and automation across SEO. You will build tools, monitoring, diagnostics and automated workflows yourself, using technology to improve the speed and quality of decision-making and helping our wider SEO teams adopt these capabilities.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and visibility. You will lead through expertise rather than formal authority, working alongside senior specialists and leaders across SEO, Product, Engineering and Analytics to shape decisions across the organisation.</p> <p>In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-own our portfolio-wide technical SEO strategy, roadmap and standards, identifying and prioritising the opportunities and risks with the greatest potential organic and commercial impact.</li> <li>Lead complex technical investigations across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, international SEO, migrations, structured data and web performance.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering on architecture, major releases, migrations and experimentation, translating technical SEO insights into clear priorities and scalable solutions.</li> <li>Build automated monitoring, diagnostics and early-warning systems that identify material technical issues before they become significant commercial problems.</li> <li>Develop internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that improve analysis, quality assurance, prioritisation and execution across technical SEO and the wider SEO organisation.</li> <li>Create reusable technical patterns, guardrails and frameworks across our portfolio, raising technical capability through coaching, documentation and shared tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Repeated technical SEO impact at scale</strong>- a strong track record of personally leading complex technical SEO initiatives across large websites or multi-domain portfolios, with clear evidence of measurable organic or commercial outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional technical SEO depth and judgement</strong>- expert knowledge across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, canonicalisation, international SEO, migrations, structured data, JavaScript SEO, log-file analysis and web performance, with the judgement to separate material opportunities from technical hygiene.</li> <li><strong>Commercial and strategic thinking</strong>- able to translate complex technical findings into priorities based on expected value, risk, effort, confidence and opportunity cost, connecting technical decisions to organic and commercial outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Principal-level influence</strong>- experienced in influencing Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders without direct authority, challenging constructively and communicating complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li><strong>A builder's mindset</strong>- intellectually curious, technically self-sufficient and comfortable remaining deeply hands-on while creating systems, standards and capabilities that increase the impact of teams beyond your own individual contribution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom.</p> <p>2nd: Interview with our Chief Gaming Officer - 60 minutes via Zoom.</p> <p>3rd: Technical SEO interview with senior members of our SEO team - 60 minutes via Zoom.</p> <p>4th: Case presentation and Principal peer interview - 90 minutes via Zoom, including a technical SEO assessment prepared ahead of the interview.</p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
