title: Head of Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description: Hi 👋🏾, I’m Abhik , Ashby’s Co-Founder and CTO. Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future. We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you! The Role In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include: Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure. Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin). Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement! Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents. Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure , including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check. You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you. If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx . If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet! A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues! The Qualifications We’re entrusting you with a company priority, so we want you to know how to scale products and build the great teams that do that. This means: You played an important role leading a company through a high-growth period (either as an IC Lead or Engineering Leader). You had to make high-quality decisions under pressure. That often meant striking a balance between short-term fixes to keep the product from falling over and long-term investments to ensure it didn’t happen again. You have experience hiring and building hiring processes, and enjoy it! You’ve designed interviews, interview loops, and led hiring strategy. You have a track record of excellent collaboration with other departments. You were a key contributor to company-level initiatives that involved Product Engineering, Product, Sales, or Support. Those departments felt heard and supported, yet positively challenged by you. You are knowledgeable about platform and infrastructure technologies, networking, and hardware. You know how Kubernetes goes beyond a Container Orchestration Platform, how traffic flows between Load Balancers and Pods, and how the intricacies of the underlying hardware can cause Cloud abstractions to break, etc. You are a great communicator, particularly in writing. You’ll need to be able to go deep with Infrastructure Engineers in conversations while also communicating those concepts to folks like myself who have much less experience. You should be comfortable managing a team spanning from the Americas West Coast to Europe. You’ll be able to hire managers to focus on specific time zones, but I expect you to have skips with some engineers (and you should want to, too!). To ensure a reasonable work schedule, we’re only hiring candidates who live in the PST-GMT time zone. What We’re Building As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back. Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help. As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are! Why You Shouldn’t Apply You’ve always been a line manager or never led a department within Engineering. You haven’t led the definition and evolution of culture and processes. You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology. We believe great leaders are folks who were great engineers themselves. That starts with loving the craft and never giving it up. You went into management because it was the only growth path available. We want folks who could have been Principal engineers (or were one!). You're happy with a team of engineers who are predominantly early-career or mid-career or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. You believe that with enough guardrails, the team can get things done. To you, a Staff or Principal Engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or conducting architecture reviews. You don’t believe staff and principal engineers could lead by the example they set or the leverage they create through their work. You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently from the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers or consistency. Engineering Culture Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through: Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design Natural collaboration and deliberate communication Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage, including LLM-driven dev tooling. Putting effort into building a diverse team Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They often discovered problems, prioritized the right ones, and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise. Traditional development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.” At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive . Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here !). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here ). To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over 4 years. ~34 hours of focus time, 2.5h of interviews, and 3.5 hours of meetings: We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region. Increase Leverage, not Team Size We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in: Great developer tooling. For example, our CI/CD takes ~10m, we deploy at least 15x a day, and our debugger works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾. Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below). AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here . description: The company It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us. manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform) We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day. The role Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell. Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them. You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up. It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses. Key responsibilities include: Build the introducer network Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there. Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens. Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us. Make referrals actually arrive A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call. Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look. Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales. Prove the channel pays Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it. The requirements We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve. Identify and implement technology and process improvements – including contributions to SQL queries, Python scripts, and pipeline tooling – to increase the efficiency and accuracy of our seaborne flow data. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems. Act as a knowledgeable and self-directed team member capable of picking up complex technical tasks independently and driving them to completion with minimal supervision. title: Member of Technical Staff
description: Slingshot AI Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want. We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London. We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others. Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want. We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London. We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others. The role As a Member of Technical Staff focused on Machine Learning, you will ship models, training infrastructure, harnesses and evals end-to-end: designing, building, and launching the tech that makes Ash differentiated as a specialized model for mental health, to change a billion minds and lives. As a core member of a small but highly skilled team, we expect you to act as an owner and to care passionately about delivering value to our users and ultimately to make people's lives better. We are looking for builders who care deeply about the quality of their work and want to ship things that make a real difference in people's lives. We care more about how you think and build than your specific background. If you're a great engineer who's curious about ML, we'd love to hear from you. We work on a model-agnostic post-training engine running on our own cluster of leased GPUs managed by SkyPilot, trained by an auto-research loop, and evaluated with our home-grown eval index aimed specifically at mental health. We’re constantly improving, and focus on building feedback loops over features, and constantly learning from our production performance, our psych research team, and scalable data sources. Our product tech stack uses Dart/Flutter for the app, Kotlin for core backend services, and Next.js/TypeScript for internal tooling, as well as Rust for low level media streaming. We use gRPC and GCP (Kubernetes, Cloud Run) as our primary cloud provider. You're not required to be an expert in all of these tools, but we would like you to come with a learning mindset and to not be afraid of getting your hands dirty with whatever tool the job might require. About you 3+ years of engineering experience, owning systems other people rely on. Experience working with LLMs, ideally with fine-tuning, harness engineering, and evals Proficient in using agents to do your homework for you Driven by creating a world-class product with a world-class team, want to own what you build, and you're happy tearing down experiments and features as we learn Experience in a fast-paced startup, or the drive to thrive in one. Collaborative and direct. You enjoy working in person with a small team. What we offer A chance to join a passionate tight knit team working on something to change the world Competitive compensation (top of personal market) and meaningful equity Travel between our NYC and London offices Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office plus a generous learning budget We cover your personal therapy Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Development Representative

title: Senior Campaign Operations Manager
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow. We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering, editorial and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Campaign Operations Manager, your role will be split roughly equally between two areas: campaign delivery, and ad tech. Campaign delivery (around 50%): You’ll own the delivery and optimisation of client advertising campaigns across Carwow Studio brands and Carwow. You’ll make sure campaigns launch accurately, perform against their KPIs and give clients an excellent experience after the sale. Ad tech and data (around 50%): You’ll be the team’s go-to expert for our advertising technology and campaign data. You’ll lead the troubleshooting of ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and data discrepancy issues. You’ll also maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows that power our reporting. Working with Product, Engineering and Data teams, you’ll help develop and integrate new tools, features and automated reporting. Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while building a reliable, efficient and scalable ad tech and data foundation for Campaign Operations. The role offers a clear path to progress to IC4 Campaign Operations Specialist. WHAT YOU'LL DO Campaign delivery Own the end-to-end delivery of advertising campaigns across channels, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives and KPIs. Monitor performance and lead optimisation with internal teams and clients to meet and exceed campaign KPIs. Act as the primary point of contact for clients after the sale, covering campaign performance and technical questions. Produce high-quality reports and post-campaign analysis decks, and present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients. Identify commercial opportunities, such as upweights, extensions and optimisations, that deliver additional value for clients and Carwow. Ad tech and data Proactively troubleshoot technical issues across ad serving platforms, creative rendering, campaign tracking and data, minimising delivery and revenue risk. Lead ad tech projects, including implementing new tools, resolving ad server and reporting discrepancies and managing technical integrations. Maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows behind campaign reporting, ensuring accuracy across internal and third-party sources. title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
description: About Zipline Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About You and The Role Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments. You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel. This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks. What You'll Do Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State) Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed What You'll Bring A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters What Else You Need To Know Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! title: Staff Software Engineer - Workloads
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.</p> <p>We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.</p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.</p> <p>You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.</p> <p>You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.</p> <p>Working alongside engineers responsible for the shared runtime and platform services, you will turn feedback from early users into better interfaces, defaults, tests and guidance. You will identify reusable patterns across integrations, shape shared platform capabilities, review designs and mentor colleagues. You will use coding agents and automation to accelerate development, applying the review, testing and domain judgement needed to ensure the resulting software behaves as intended.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering skills, demonstrated through dependable software or developer tools used by other people.</li> <li>Applied depth in at least one relevant area, such as robotics simulation, autonomous-vehicle evaluation, reinforcement learning, synthetic-data generation or engineering simulation.</li> <li>Experience making specialist or research software usable beyond its original author, including configuration, testing, documentation and diagnosis.</li> <li>Sound judgement about experimental assumptions, evaluation criteria, reproducibility and the conclusions a result supports.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerised execution and experience tracing problems across application and infrastructure boundaries.</li> <li>Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and domains, working closely with specialists and recognising when their expertise is needed.</li> <li>Evidence of improving shared tools or engineering practices across multiple projects, with clear reasoning about what should be common and what should remain application-specific.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Python, Go or C++.</li> <li>Familiarity with simulation and machine-learning frameworks.</li> <li>Experience profiling GPU workloads and identifying performance or resource bottlenecks.</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes or workflow orchestration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You enjoy turning specialist Physical AI software into dependable tools that other researchers and engineers can use independently.</li> <li>You care about making experiments understandable and reproducible, with clear evidence of what their results do and do not establish.</li> <li>You combine hands-on engineering with curiosity about unfamiliar domains, and enjoy helping colleagues build reusable, high-quality systems.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome relevant experience from industry, research engineering and academia. We are interested in what you have built, how others use it and the judgement you brought to making it work.</p> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role is £116,000 to £155,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Physical AI Engineering Team</strong> at <strong>CoreWeave</strong> is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.</p> <p>As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>We’re seeking a <strong>Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems</strong> to help design and build this layer.</p> <p>This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of <strong>distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure</strong>.</p> <p>You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.</p> <p>A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.</p> <p>You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Runtime Systems & Architecture</strong></li> <li>Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.</li> <li>Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.</li> <li>Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.</li> <li>Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.</li> <li>Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.</li> <li><strong>Execution Models & Contracts</strong></li> <li>Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.</li> <li>Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.</li> <li>Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.</li> <li>Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.</li> <li>Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Systems Engineering</strong></li> <li>Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.</li> <li>Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.</li> <li>Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.</li> <li>Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.</li> <li><strong>Performance & Experimentation</strong></li> <li>Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.</li> <li>Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.</li> <li>Build repeatable workload and benchmark environments.</li> <li>Use evidence from real execution to challenge assumptions and guide platform development.</li> <li><strong>Technical Leadership</strong></li> <li>Lead ambiguous systems problems where the correct architecture is not yet known.</li> <li>Reduce complex problems into smaller contracts and mechanisms that can actually be implemented.</li> <li>Challenge unnecessary abstraction and simplify designs where complexity has outgrown its value.</li> <li>Influence technical direction across teams without requiring direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to technical hiring and engineering standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience building complex systems software, distributed infrastructure, runtimes, workflow systems, or adjacent technology.</li> <li>Deep expertise in at least one of:</li> <ul> <li>Distributed systems</li> <li>Runtime systems</li> <li>Workflow or execution engines</li> <li>Programming languages, compilers, or interpreters</li> <li>Cluster scheduling and orchestration</li> <li>High-performance or systems software</li> </ul> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals and production coding ability.</li> <li>Experience designing APIs, protocols, schemas, or contracts between independently evolving systems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of distributed-system failure modes, state, authority, retries, concurrency, and side effects.</li> <li>Strong technical judgement around when abstraction helps and when it simply moves complexity elsewhere.</li> <li>Comfortable entering unfamiliar technical domains and building depth quickly.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and experience influencing architectural decisions across teams.</li> </ul> <p>Experience with some of the following would be valuable, but is not required:</p> <ul> <li>Go, Rust, C/C++, or Python.</li> <li>Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure.</li> <li>Argo, OSMO, Temporal, Ray, Kubeflow, or similar systems.</li> <li>GPU clusters or large-scale AI infrastructure.</li> <li>High-performance computing.</li> <li>Simulation, robotics, autonomous systems, or Physical AI.</li> <li>Programming language or compiler research.</li> <li>Performance engineering.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure at scale.</li> <li>Platforms designed to be operated by autonomous software or AI agents.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match.</strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Thinker:</strong> You ask where authority lives, what guarantees actually exist, and what happens when systems fail.</li> <li><strong>Technically Deep:</strong> You want to understand how systems really behave, not just how they are supposed to behave.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic:</strong> You value elegant engineering, but care more about whether it works for real workloads.</li> <li><strong>Evidence-Driven:</strong> You test assumptions and change direction when the evidence says you should.</li> <li><strong>Strong Technical Leader:</strong> You can form a view, challenge senior stakeholders, and bring others with you.</li> <li><strong>Commercially Aware:</strong> You understand that technical decisions need to improve customer outcomes, engineering velocity, reliability, or economics.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mentality:</strong> You take responsibility for getting difficult systems into production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support entrepreneurial thinking, independent judgement, and collaboration. You’ll work alongside some of the best talent in the industry on technically difficult problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p&

initiatives, and serve as a trusted resource for lawyers and business stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role requiring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced global environment.</p> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Skills</span></h2> <p>A successful candidate will be able to:</p> <ul> <li>Manage the appointments, board and shareholder approvals, statutory filings, powers of attorney, and corporate recordkeeping.</li> <li>Liaise with corporate secretarial service providers and internal process improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the legal function.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Experience and Qualifications</span></h2> <p>A successful candidate will have:</p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 10 years of paralegal, corporate governance, legal operations, or related legal experience.</li> <li>Experience supporting corporate entities across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with corporate governance requirements and entity management practices.</li> <li>Experience reviewing and administering NDAs and other routine commercial agreements.</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.</li> <li>High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.</li> <li>Proficiency with AI tools, Microsoft Office applications, and legal technology tools.</li> <li>Experience working in a multinational or international company with operations across Europe and other regions.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Our Commitment</span></h2> <p>Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3> </h3> <h3><strong>Group Overview</strong></h3> <p>This role sits within Platform Group area of Metrea. The Platform Group rovides the Information Technology and Information Systems ecosystem that Metrea is utilising for the day-to-day operations, communication, collaboration and information sharing across its Platform business block.</p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>In this role, you will lead the design and operation of secure, reliable Azure platforms that enable Metrea's UK teams to build, deploy, and support mission-focused services with confidence. You will shape how we use Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, automation, and DevSecOps practices to improve delivery speed, platform resilience, and developer experience. </p> <p>You will be successful if you can combine hands-on engineering depth with technical leadership: solving complex platform challenges, mentoring others, and making pragmatic decisions for sensitive defence environments. </p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, implement and operate secure, scalable Azure platform services, primarily supporting MITO programmes and UK engineering teams.</li> CI/CD pipelines for repeatable, controlled and secure software delivery.</li> <li>Develop secure deployment patterns for AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including model integrations, automated evaluation and controlled releases.</li> <li>Deploy and secure AI platform components such as model APIs, LLM workloads and MCP servers, with appropriate access controls, secrets management and data boundaries.</li> <li>Build and optimise containerised workloads using Docker and AKS, with resilient and repeatable deployment patterns.</li> <li>Implement DevSecOps practices including policy as code, vulnerability management, secrets management and software supply-chain controls.</li> <li>Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting and service-health reporting across platforms and workloads.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, identity, security, pipeline and production issues affecting business-critical services.</li> <li>Advise and mentor engineers, promote effective platform practices and help teams adopt reusable, self-service tooling.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a senior DevOps, platform, cloud or infrastructure engineering role supporting business-critical services.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating Microsoft Azure environments.</li> <li>Deep experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub, including CI/CD pipelines, release controls and deployment automation.</li> <li>Proven infrastructure-as-code experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates or comparable technologies.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and AKS, including resilient and automated deployment patterns.</li> <li>Experience implementing DevSecOps controls across infrastructure, pipelines and the software supply chain.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, with exposure to model APIs, LLM deployments or MCP.</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting capability across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, observability and software delivery.</li> <li>Ability to influence technical direction, mentor engineers and work effectively across software, platform, security and support teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></h3> <h3> </h3> <ul> <li>Deploying or operating locally hosted LLMs or GPU-based model-serving infrastructure.</li> <li>Securing MCP servers, agent permissions and access to sensitive tools or data.</li> <li>Backstage or another internal developer platform, including reusable templates and self-service workflows.</li> <li>Experience in defence, government or another regulated environment.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Additional Eligibility Qualifications</strong></h3> <div> <p>The successful candidate must be able to qualify for UK Security Clearance.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul>  </li> <li>Free lunch on office days  </li> <li>Enhanced Parental Leave  </li> <li>30 days annual PTO plus b/h  </li> <li>Bonus Scheme  </li> <li>Personal development opportunities </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Work Authorization / Security Clearance</strong></h3> <p>The employee will have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom and will be able to produce right to work documentation. </p> <h3><strong>AAP/EEO Statement</strong></h3> <p>Metrea Management Limited (MAM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  </p> <h3><strong>Position Type and Expected Hours of Work</strong></h3> <p>This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.  </p> <h3><strong>Work Environment</strong></h3> <p>This job operates in a hybrid work setting, with 3 days in the office. title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.</p> <p>As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.</p> <p>Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.</p> <p>You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.</p> <p>Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.</p> <p>As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <p>AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.</p> <ul> <li>At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.</li> <li>Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.</li> <li>Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.</li> <li>Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.</li> <li>Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.</li> <li>Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p><strong>Access to controlled technology</strong></p> <p>Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p>Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad.<br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Infrastructure IT, and other platform teams to build, enhance, and support our developer platform. You will help define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and deliver medium-to-large platform projects from implementation through    production</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Drive cloud cost efficiency and optimization across our cloud and infrastructure</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response</li> <li>Help evolve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations and incident response</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5–7 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver defined projects independently</li> <li>Clear communication and strong collaboration skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or tooling</li> <li>Exposure to regulated or high-availability environments</li> <li>Backend development experience (Java, Python, Go, or similar)</li> <li>Familiarity with observability and reliability engineering practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery. </p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Travel Expectations</strong></p> <p>Periodic travel to the United States is expected for offsites, planning sessions, and collaboration. Occasional travel within the UK and Ireland may also be required.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong> just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive
description: <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.</p> <h2>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Win new enterprise logos.</strong> Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.</li> <li><strong>Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</strong> Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.</li> <li><strong>Sell a platform, not a point solution.</strong> Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.</li> <li><strong>Run the full sales lifecycle.</strong> Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.</li> <li><strong>Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements.</strong> Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.</li> <li><strong>Partner cross-functionally.</strong> Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.</li> <li><strong>Be a trusted advisor.</strong> Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.</li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota</li> <li>You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals</li> <li>You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry</li> <li>You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations</li> <li>You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews</li> <li>You are an outstanding presenter in person and virtually, with strong business acumen and natural curiosity</li> <li>You are self-driven, organised and comfortable managing a long, multi-threaded pipeline with forecast discipline</li> <li>You are tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; you have worked with Salesforce, RFP management tools or similar systems</li> <li>You are open to regular travel across EMEA to meet clients face-to-face</li> <li>Nice to have: fluency in a second European language, and experience selling CRM, marketing, reservations, PMS or POS technology</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
